rule.name: Product ID or NDC is Invalid
rule.description: National Drug Code (NDC) is missing, invalid format, or not found in drug database

conditions.description: NDC must be exactly 11 digits (5-4-2 format)

detection_logic.python_logic: if not ndc or str(ndc) == 'nan' or len(str(ndc)) != 11: return 204

product_code.description: Specific drug product (strength, dosage form, formulation)

ndc_format.notes: NDC may be stored with or without hyphens. Validation checks digit count only.

data_field.name: DRUG_NDC
data_field.description: National Drug Code uniquely identifying the drug product

test_cases.name: Valid NDC - with hyphens (stored as text)

expected_output.reason: NDC with hyphens has length 13 (hyphens counted). NOTE: This is a known limitation - current implementation counts hyphens.

known_issues.description: Current implementation counts hyphens in length check
known_issues.impact: Valid NDCs like '12345-6789-01' flagged as invalid
known_issues.workaround: Store NDCs without hyphens in database
known_issues.fix_required: Update logic to: ndc_clean = str(ndc).replace('-', ''); if len(ndc_clean) != 11: return 204

rule.business_rationale: NDC is essential for identifying the exact drug product, calculating rebates, and verifying formulary status. Invalid NDCs prevent proper pricing.

resolution_guidance.missing_ndc: Check original pharmacy claim, verify data extraction
resolution_guidance.invalid_format: Verify NDC against FDA database, check for transcription errors
resolution_guidance.not_in_database: Update drug master file, verify NDC is active

enhancement_opportunities.benefit: Prevent false positives on hyphenated NDCs
enhancement_opportunities.implementation: ndc_digits = ''.join(c for c in str(ndc) if c.isdigit())

enhancement_opportunities.description: Verify NDC exists in FDA database or internal master file
enhancement_opportunities.benefit: Catch typos and invalid NDCs that pass format check
enhancement_opportunities.implementation: Check against reference table of valid NDCs

enhancement_opportunities.description: Validate each segment (labeler, product, package) separately
enhancement_opportunities.benefit: More specific error messages for troubleshooting
enhancement_opportunities.implementation: Parse and validate each segment of 5-4-2 format

related_codes_description.203: Product date range validation requires valid NDC

implementation.order: Checked AFTER data quality rules (101-104) and BEFORE formulary checks (201)

statistics.notes: Most common dispute code. High occurrence suggests data quality issues in source systems.

data_quality_insights.recommendation: Implement NDC validation at data entry point
data_quality_insights.vendor_training: Educate vendors on proper NDC formatting
data_quality_insights.system_enhancement: Add NDC lookup service to catch errors earlier
